final: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, COUNT(*) as track_count, AVG(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId), overall_avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) as avg_count FROM media_stats), kept_groups AS (SELECT ms.avg_ratio, ms.track_count, ms.track_count - oac.avg_count as difference FROM media_stats ms CROSS JOIN overall_avg_count oac WHERE ms.track_count > oac.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio, SUM(track_count) as total_count, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM kept_groups
